sentences.en: And they found themselves in a magical world called Narnia.
sentences.zh: 1. 而他们发现自己来到了一个叫做纳尼亚的神奇世界。

sentences.en: This will be another magical evening with our extended family.

sentences.en: They were under the magical influence of the night.
sentences.zh: 3. 他们被夜色的魔力影响着。
